$comment: Advisories we have looked at and decided to carry, each with the reason and a
review date. Anything NOT listed here fails the gate — that is the point: the
old check compared three hardcoded rules and passed the mermaid prototype
An entry is a decision, not a mute. 'reason' has to say why the vulnerable path
is unreachable HERE, not that the package is popular or the severity looks low.
When 'review' passes, the gate warns; that is the prompt to re-check reachability
rather than extend the date reflexively.
An entry names the advisory IDs it covers. A new advisory against an
allowlisted package fails the gate until someone re-checks reachability

allow.reason: src/browser/web-ai/context-pack/file-selector.ts checks every final include and ignore pattern before fast-glob, rejecting more than 32 total raw opening braces or parentheses. These are the only recursive AST container openers in braces 3.0.3, so this entrypoint cannot reach the advisory's unbounded nesting. src/manager/notes/system-trash.ts calls trash with glob:false, bypassing its globby/fast-glob/brace-expansion path. No patched upstream version exists at review time. This decision covers only GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm nesting, not arbitrary expansion/cardinality risks.
